title: *My Dreadful Body*
subtitle: By Egana Djabbarova of Azerbaijan. A wonderful short novel, and as described by Olga Grjasnowa “An extraordinary novel that translates corporality and estrangement into language.” Here is the Amazon link. This has been a fantastic year for fiction, and in November I will be writing up a report.

By Egana Djabbarova of Azerbaijan.  A wonderful short novel, and as described by Olga Grjasnowa “An extraordinary novel that translates corporality and estrangement into language.”  Here is the Amazon link.

This has been a fantastic year for fiction, and in November I will be writing up a report.
